# HUD colours

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/hud-colours.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The colour table `CL` scripts use in text (`<COLOR rrggbbaa>`) and the HUD slots `CfgHUDColor`
assigns from it.

14 entries. Data: `research/references/hud-colours.yaml`.

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |

| `swatch` | str |  | A swatch of the colour (rendered). |
